principles: Offline adjudication only: read committed evidence, never re-execute the instrument or the CLI
Three-state (pass|fail|inconclusive) is first-class — missing/insufficient/tampered evidence must never read as pass
Reproducible digest over a canonical preimage so a second host can replicate offline
Reuse lib/instrument.mjs sha256/canonicalJson — one hashing convention
Clean separation: M1-M3 produce evidence, M4 only adjudicates it
drivers: The four committed evidence streams (batch-ledger/tamper-verdicts/resume-reconciliation/protocol) are the sole inputs
The report digest must replicate byte-identically cross-host, offline
Missing or tampered evidence must map to inconclusive or fail, never a false pass

options.name: offline-committed-evidence-analyzer
cons: adjudication limited to what the committed evidence records

rationale: Offline adjudication over the committed evidence keeps M4 deterministic and cross-host replicable and preserves the produce(M1-M3)/adjudicate(M4) separation; re-running the instrument would recouple and de-determinize the capstone.

preMortem.scenario: A missing or truncated evidence file silently reads as pass
preMortem.trigger: An evidence file is absent, empty, or truncated when analyze-batch runs
preMortem.consequence: A false all-pass report — the campaign claims proof it does not have
preMortem.mitigation: Three-state: missing/insufficient evidence maps to inconclusive (never pass); selfcheck-m4 feeds missing/short inputs and asserts inconclusive

preMortem.scenario: The digest is not reproducible cross-host
preMortem.trigger: The report embeds a timestamp/random value or uses non-canonical (unsorted) serialization in the digested preimage
preMortem.consequence: Cross-host digest mismatch — the trust anchor is lost
preMortem.mitigation: digest = sha256(canonicalJson(report minus the digest field)); no Date/random in the preimage; selfcheck asserts two runs produce the identical digest

preMortem.scenario: Tampered evidence edited to look conforming passes
preMortem.trigger: An evidence field is edited to fake conformance
preMortem.mitigation: selfcheck-m4 mutates evidence (flip a dispositionMatch, over-cap an elapsedMs, set gapTotal>0) and asserts the verdict flips to fail/inconclusive; report records each input file sha256
